name: RepoQA
intro: RepoQA是一个旨在评估大型语言模型（LLMs）长上下文代码理解能力的基准测试。它通过“搜索针函数”（SNF）任务来挑战LLMs，要求模型根据自然语言描述搜索代码函数，这需要模型深入理解代码和描述。RepoQA是多语言且全面的，包含从50个流行代码库中收集的500个代码搜索任务，涵盖5种现代编程语言。
org: University of Washington, Google, ETH Zurich
build_method: GitHub仓库抓取, Tree-Sitter语法抽取, 针函数植入
eval_feature: 多语言, 长上下文 (16K-128K), 大海捞针检索
build_method_en: GitHub repository crawling, Tree-Sitter AST extraction, Needle-in-haystack synthesis
intro_en: RepoQA is a benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' (LLMs) long-context code understanding ability. It challenges LLMs with the "Search Needle Function" (SNF) task, requiring models to search for code functions based on natural language descriptions, demanding deep comprehension of both code and descriptions. RepoQA is multilingual and comprehensive, containing 500 code search tasks collected from 50 popular code repositories, covering 5 modern programming languages.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with RepoQA arXiv:2406.06025 Sections 3-4 and Appendix, evaluated against official EvalPlus repoqa release. RepoQA evaluates long-context code comprehension via the Search Needle Function (SNF) task across 50 popular repositories in 5 programming languages (Python, C++, Java, TypeScript, Rust). Track A models repository dependency sorting, Tree-Sitter AST function extraction (<=2KB), needle selection (10 functions/repo, 500 total), GPT-4 description generation, and the needle disambiguation decision gate ensuring unique target identification before freezing 500 tasks. Track B models long-context needle planting across 16K-128K token contexts at 10%-100% depths, model needle search, Tree-Sitter block extraction, and exact match / CodeBLEU >= 0.8 retrieval accuracy reporting.
